card.name: Partway through long drug words
card.fires_on: Fires on the middle piece of a long drug or medical word that is split up, such as hydrob-rom-ide, es-mol-ol, myel-os-uppression or arr-hythm-ias. Also fires on a few number or time pieces.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: Middle pieces of split drug names such as eletriptan hydrobromide and esmolol.

modes.label: Inside medical terms
modes.description: Middle pieces of split clinical terms like myelosuppression, glottis and arrhythmias.

modes.label: Digits in dose timing
modes.description: A digit starting or inside a number of minutes or hours.
modes.example: Should symptoms persist for <<1>>0 minutes after administration of CARDAMYST

card.writes: It suppresses 'temporary' and 'transient' words, with no clear push toward any particular next word.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of long, split-up drug and medical words, where the word is not yet finished.
